description: The modular workflow automates the entire data pipeline, processing diverse input sources, including UAV-derived vegetation indices, sensor observations, field metadata, and weather data. It generates standardised crop model inputs and simulation-ready datasets, for example, for DSSAT. The workflow integrates specialised tools for vegetation index processing, phenology analysis, and data transformation, supporting reproducible, portable, and scalable high-throughput crop simulations.
name: UC6 - Automated Data Flows for Crop Simulation Models
